REPORT
Date February 16, 1940.

Subject John Chester WILSON

Made by. D.S. McKeown Forwarded by. D.I. Crawford

According to the records of the Linotype
and Machinery Ltd., 160 Avenue Edward VII, John
Chester WILSON, Canadian, aged 37, came to Shanghai
in 1931 and obtained a situation in the firm at the
beginning of 1932. An excellent technician, his
services were invaluable, but his quarrelsome nature
soon alienated the sympathies of the rest of the
firm, and his habit of signing chits in the managing
director's name was partly responsible for him being
requested to resign in January, 1934. He was given
three months' pay in lieu of notice, amounting to
£125. Since that time, he has obtained and lost
several positions, among them being appointments in
XOHA Radio Station, the Mercantile Printing Co.,
Wakefield Oil Company. He is at present an agent
for the Pacific American Trading Company, 80 Szechuen
Road. In July, 1939, WILSON approached the manager
of the last named firm and requested that he be
given a chance to prove his worth. He was appointed
agent at a low salary which has been repeatedly
increased and he is at present earning $375 per
month. The manager, Mr. I. MARANTZ (American)
stated confidentially that he intends to dismiss
WILSON at the end of the current month, again owing
to his quarrelsome nature and the fact that he is
repeatedly borrowing money from the firm. On several
occasions, WILSON has involved Mr. MARANTZ in
difficulties. About three months ago, the latter

报告
日期：1940年2月16日。

事由：约翰·切斯特·威尔逊（John Chester WILSON）

制作人：D.S. McKeown 转呈人：D.I. Crawford

根据爱德华七世路160号莱诺铸排机有限公司（Linotype and Machinery Ltd.）的记录，加拿大人约翰·切斯特·威尔逊，37岁，于1931年来到上海，并于1932年初在该公司获得职位。他是一名优秀的技术员，其服务极具价值，但他好争辩的性格很快使公司其他人员对他产生反感，而且他惯于以总经理的名义签写欠条，这部分导致他在1934年1月被要求辞职。公司支付了他三个月的薪水作为代通知金，共计125英镑。自那时起，他获得并失去了数个职位，其中包括在XOHA广播电台、商业印刷公司（Mercantile Printing Co.）、韦克菲尔德石油公司（Wakefield Oil Company）的任职。他目前是四川路80号太平洋美商贸易公司（Pacific American Trading Company）的代理人。1939年7月，威尔逊接洽上述公司的经理，请求给予一个证明其价值的机会。他被任命为代理人，起薪较低，但经过多次增加，目前月薪为375美元。经理I. MARANTZ先生（美国人）私下表示，他打算在本月底解雇威尔逊，原因再次是其好争辩的性格，以及他反复向公司借钱的事实。威尔逊曾多次使MARANTZ先生陷入困境。大约三个月前，后者

was called by WILSON to the Yangtsze Hotel, Hankow
Road, where WILSON had passed a counterfeit $10 note,
apparently unwittingly, and had no money to replace
it. Mr. MARANTZ proceeded to the hotel and lent
WILSON $10. At that time WILSON was living with a
woman who appeared to be Russian and whom he
introduced as his wife. He is still living with
this female in a house in Hongkew, the address of
which is being obtained by the manager and will be
forwarded as soon as possible.

When WILSON approached the Pacific
American Trading, he was told that he would have
to obtain a bond as he would have access to valuable
stores. An application was made to an insurance
company but their reply stated that although they
could find nothing to the detriment of WILSON's
character, they were unwilling to provide him with
a bond.

A personal knowledge of WILSON shows him
to be a capable business man but slightly unbalanced
and his superiority complex invariably results in his
quarrelling with his employers. He has periodic
drinking bouts, at which times he is irresponsible
and taking advantage of his excellent physique, he
has often become involved in bar and cabaret brawls.
At present, WILSON is living from hand to mouth, and
it is doubtful if his assets would reach $500.

A.C.(Special Branch).

被威尔逊叫至汉口路扬子饭店，威尔逊在那里使用了一张伪造的10美元钞票，显然并非故意，且无钱赔偿。MARANTZ先生前往该饭店，借给威尔逊10美元。当时，威尔逊与一名看似俄罗斯籍的女子同居，并介绍其为妻子。他目前仍与该女子住在虹口的一处住宅中，经理正在获取该地址，并将尽快转呈。

当威尔逊接洽太平洋美商贸易公司时，他被告知必须取得担保债券，因为他将接触贵重存货。公司向一家保险公司提出申请，但回复称，虽然未发现任何有损威尔逊品行之事，但不愿为其提供担保债券。

对威尔逊的个人了解显示，他是一位能干的商人，但精神略有不稳，其优越感 invariably 导致他与雇主发生争吵。他有周期性的酗酒行为，在此期间他不负责任，并仗着体格健壮，经常卷入酒吧和歌舞厅的斗殴。目前，威尔逊生活拮据，入不敷出，其资产能否达到500美元尚存疑问。

特别股助理督察。
Jhj阅
D. S.
